user_story:
As a user, I want to be able to view items in my shopping cart so that I can proceed to checkout or continue shopping. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. The shopping cart page should display 'Your Cart' with the selector [data-test="title"]. 
2. There should be a button to continue shopping with the selector [data-test="continue-shopping"]. 
3. There should be a button to proceed to checkout with the selector [data-test="checkout"].
4. The cart should have 'QTY' and 'Description' labels visible using the selectors [data-test="cart-quantity-label"] and [data-test="cart-desc-label"].
